description: Standalone Maryland center acquisition and offline normalization with durable application receipts and explicit retained-input reuse.

acquiredManifestPath.description: Explicit verified retained acquisition; omission selects fixed native collection.

output_schema_contract.zip: Separate ZIP5 and ZIP4; ZIP4 not provided by selected source
output_schema_contract.geocode: Nullable provider-returned latitude/longitude only; no business polygons
output_schema_contract.entity: Dated licensed-center source candidates, not verified current businesses or premises

redirect_policy: Fixed native Maryland URLs, no redirects or credentials; retained mode performs no source requests.
publisher_exclusion: Native app acquisition owns data/business-sources/md-childcare/runtime/publisher.lock across output roots until child writers drain and terminal persistence completes. Unknown locks are never stolen. Injected tests and retained offline work do not take the native publisher lock.
retry: No automatic retries or restart; preserve completed acquisition for explicit offline reuse without repulling.
checkpoint: Persist start before acquisition and verified acquired/normalized references after each child publication, including child commit-boundary cancellation; publish terminal receipt last without overwrite.
idempotency: Immutable UUID app and child outputs. Native/injected jobs cannot borrow another job's children; retained mode pins explicitly selected input. No source-current or national pointer updates.
cancellation: Cooperative 30-minute deadline and drained writers before terminal persistence and ownership release; preserve published evidence on cancellation/failure. Forced termination or OS stalls require inspection.
retention_profile: Internal source candidates, quarantine and linked app receipts, preserving missing fields and unverified address, identity and current operations.
